rules.sentence: Low-grade central osteosarcoma comprises 1% to 2% of all osteosarcomas.[20]
Immunohistochemically, amplification of MDM2 and CDK4 can help differentiate low-grade osteosarcoma from other benign intramedullary bone tumors.[22]
Progression to a high-grade osteosarcoma has been documented in the setting of local recurrence.[21]
